roles/aiplatform.admin.title: Agent Platform Administrator
roles/aiplatform.admin.desc: Grants full access to all resources in Agent Platform.

roles/aiplatform.agentSandboxServiceAgen.title: Vertex AI Agent Sandbox Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.agentSandboxServiceAgen.desc: Vertex AI Service Agent used to access Agent Sandbox managed resources in consumer project with restricted permissions.

roles/aiplatform.batchPredictionServiceA.title: Vertex AI Batch Prediction Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.batchPredictionServiceA.desc: Vertex AI Batch Prediction Service Agent for serving batch prediction requests.

roles/aiplatform.colabEnterpriseAdmin.title: Colab Enterprise Admin
roles/aiplatform.colabEnterpriseAdmin.desc: Admin role of using colab enterprise.

roles/aiplatform.colabEnterpriseUser.title: Colab Enterprise User
roles/aiplatform.colabEnterpriseUser.desc: User role of using colab enterprise.

roles/aiplatform.colabServiceAgent.title: Vertex AI Colab Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.colabServiceAgent.desc: Gives Vertex AI Colab the proper permissions to function.

roles/aiplatform.customCodeServiceAgent.title: Vertex AI Custom Code Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.customCodeServiceAgent.desc: Gives Vertex AI Custom Code the proper permissions. The aiplatform.customJobs.create IAM permission is highly privileged. Through Vertex AI Custom Training jobs, it effectively grants editor-level access to other services activated for the consumer project, such as GCS and BigQuery.

roles/aiplatform.entityTypeOwner.title: Agent Platform Feature Store EntityType owner
roles/aiplatform.entityTypeOwner.desc: Provides full access to all permissions for a particular entity type resource.

roles/aiplatform.extensionCustomCodeServ.title: Vertex AI Extension Custom Code Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.extensionCustomCodeServ.desc: Gives Vertex AI Extension that executes custom code the permissions it needs to function.

roles/aiplatform.extensionServiceAgent.title: Vertex AI Extension Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.extensionServiceAgent.desc: Gives Vertex AI Extension the permissions it needs to function.

roles/aiplatform.featurestoreAdmin.title: Agent Platform Feature Store Admin
roles/aiplatform.featurestoreAdmin.desc: Grants full access to all resources in Agent Platform Feature Store.

roles/aiplatform.featurestoreDataViewer.title: Agent Platform Feature Store Data Viewer
roles/aiplatform.featurestoreDataViewer.desc: This role provides permissions to read Feature data.

roles/aiplatform.featurestoreDataWriter.title: Agent Platform Feature Store Data Writer
roles/aiplatform.featurestoreDataWriter.desc: This role provides permissions to read and write Feature data.

roles/aiplatform.featurestoreInstanceCre.title: Agent Platform Feature Store Instance Creator
roles/aiplatform.featurestoreInstanceCre.desc: Administrator of Featurestore resources, but not the child resources under Featurestores.

roles/aiplatform.featurestoreResourceVie.title: Agent Platform Feature Store Resource Viewer
roles/aiplatform.featurestoreResourceVie.desc: Viewer of all resources in Agent Platform Feature Store but cannot make changes.

roles/aiplatform.memoryEditor.title: Agent Platform Memory Bank Editor Role
roles/aiplatform.memoryEditor.desc: Grants edit access to Agent Platform Memory Bank.

roles/aiplatform.memoryUser.title: Agent Platform Memory Bank User Role
roles/aiplatform.memoryUser.desc: Grants full user access to Agent Platform Memory Bank.

roles/aiplatform.memoryViewer.title: Agent Platform Memory Bank Viewer Role
roles/aiplatform.memoryViewer.desc: Grants viewer access to Agent Platform Memory Bank.

roles/aiplatform.migrator.title: Agent Platform Migration Service User
roles/aiplatform.migrator.desc: Grants access to use migration service in Agent Platform

roles/aiplatform.modelMonitoringServiceA.title: Vertex AI Model Monitoring Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.modelMonitoringServiceA.desc: Gives Vertex AI Model Monitoring the permissions it needs to function.

roles/aiplatform.notebookRuntimeAdmin.title: Notebook Runtime Admin
roles/aiplatform.notebookRuntimeAdmin.desc: Grants full access to all runtime templates and runtimes in Notebook Service.

roles/aiplatform.notebookRuntimeUser.title: Notebook Runtime User
roles/aiplatform.notebookRuntimeUser.desc: Grants users permissions to create runtime resources using a runtime template and manage the runtime resources they created.

roles/aiplatform.notebookServiceAgent.title: Vertex AI Notebook Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.notebookServiceAgent.desc: Vertex AI Service Agent used to run Notebook managed resources in user project with restricted permissions.

roles/aiplatform.onlinePredictionService.title: Vertex AI Online Prediction Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.onlinePredictionService.desc: Gives Vertex AI Online Prediction the permissions it needs to function.

roles/aiplatform.ragServiceAgent.title: Vertex AI RAG Data Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.ragServiceAgent.desc: Vertex AI Service Agent used by Vertex RAG to access user imported data, Vertex AI, Document AI processors, and Vector Search in the project

roles/aiplatform.rapidevalServiceAgent.title: Vertex AI Rapid Eval Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.rapidevalServiceAgent.desc: Vertex AI Service Agent used by GenAI Rapid Evaluation Service to access publisher model endpoints in the user project

roles/aiplatform.reasoningEngineServiceA.title: Vertex AI Reasoning Engine Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.reasoningEngineServiceA.desc: Gives Vertex AI Reasoning Engine the proper permissions to function. The aiplatform.reasoningEngines.create IAM permission implies read access to the GCS objects of the consumer project through this service agent.

roles/aiplatform.serviceAgent.title: Vertex AI Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.serviceAgent.desc: Gives Vertex AI the permissions it needs to function.

roles/aiplatform.sessionEditor.title: Agent Platform Sessions Editor Role
roles/aiplatform.sessionEditor.desc: Grants edit access to Agent Platform Sessions.

roles/aiplatform.sessionUser.title: Agent Platform Sessions User Role
roles/aiplatform.sessionUser.desc: Grants full user access to Agent Platform Sessions.

roles/aiplatform.sessionViewer.title: Agent Platform Sessions Viewer Role
roles/aiplatform.sessionViewer.desc: Grants viewer access to Agent Platform Sessions

roles/aiplatform.telemetryServiceAgent.title: Vertex AI Telemetry Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.telemetryServiceAgent.desc: Allows Vertex AI Telemetry Service Agent to access telemetry data.

roles/aiplatform.tuningServiceAgent.title: Vertex AI Tuning Service Agent
roles/aiplatform.tuningServiceAgent.desc: Vertex AI Service Agent used for tuning in user project.

roles/aiplatform.user.title: Agent Platform User
roles/aiplatform.user.desc: Grants access to use all resource in Agent Platform.

roles/aiplatform.viewer.title: Agent Platform Viewer
roles/aiplatform.viewer.desc: Grants access to view all resource in Agent Platform.
